QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Corrupt Energy
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Eremos about the next step in your training.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos warns you of the dangers that lurk along the path of truth. You must travel to the Golden Temple and defeat 1,500 evil monsters.
QuestInfo.2: Defeated the monsters in Golden Temple was no easy task, but it was well worth the improvement to your skills and training.
